Values lifted from lib/config/app_ds.dart — #F5F5F5 canvas, #409843 header with a 28px bottom radius, white 16px cards at 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.06), #1A1A1A / #666 / #999 text, badge blue #1DA1F2 and gold #FFD700.
Bottom bar order is Magazine · News · Home · Explore · More, so the raised notch lands dead centre on Home.
